title: LPSC 2026 1958: Blue Ghost Mission 1 Mission Retrospective (Tackett/Marlin/Coogan)
quote_after_sunset: As intended, Blue Ghost operated five hours after the end of the lunar day, sending back photos of the sunset and possible dust levitation, a phenomenon first reported by Apollo astronauts.
quote_not_designed: The mission was concluded as Blue Ghost was not designed to survive the cold lunar night.
note: Prints five hours after the end of the lunar day and 400 watts of power as vehicle resource (with comms; not labeled peak vs night keep-alive). Not designed to survive the cold lunar night. Looking-forward BGM2/LuSEE is not mixed into the BGM1 court.
